queries.query: ("large language model" OR LLM OR "foundation model") AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps OR "intent-to-configuration" OR "configuration generation" OR "configuration synthesis")
queries.rationale: Locate primary work where generative models directly produce network configs or translate operator intent into configurations.

queries.query: (hallucinat* OR "failure mode" OR error OR incorrect*) AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "foundation model") AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration" OR routing OR firewall)
queries.rationale: Identify studies characterizing LLM output errors relevant to correctness and safety in network tasks (hallucination, omission, spurious values).

queries.query: ("generate-validate-repair" OR "generate-then-validate" OR "generate-validate" OR "LLM" AND (validator OR verifier OR "self-correction" OR repair OR "iterative refinement")) AND (network OR "network configuration" OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Find architectures that pair generation with validators/repair loops, especially applied to network configuration tasks.

queries.query: ("network verification" OR Veriflow OR Batfish OR "formal verification" OR reachability OR "policy compliance") AND (validation OR verifier OR "configuration correctness")
queries.rationale: Survey deterministic/formal tools used to check network configs, to evaluate candidate validators for LLM outputs or hybrid pipelines.

queries.query: (benchmark OR benchmark* OR evaluation OR "evaluation methodology") AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR "foundation model") AND (network OR NetOps OR "AIOps" OR "networking benchmark" OR "NetOps benchmark")
queries.rationale: Collect existing benchmarks and critiques to assess ecological and construct validity of evaluations for LLMs in NetOps.

queries.query: (prompt OR "prompt engineering" OR "chain of thought" OR "few-shot" OR "in-context learning") AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps OR "operational workflow")
queries.rationale: Understand methodological levers (prompting, CoT, few-shot) that affect LLM NetOps outputs and sensitivity analyses.

queries.query: (agent OR agentic OR "LLM agent" OR "autonomous agent" OR orchestrator OR "multi-agent") AND (NetOps OR network OR "network operations" OR "network management")
queries.rationale: Identify prior work on agentic/autonomous systems that orchestrate multi-step NetOps workflows with LLMs or other planners.

queries.query: (robustness OR adversarial OR robustness-testing OR "stress test") AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR "configuration")
queries.rationale: Gather literature on adversarial/robustness testing of LLMs in operational contexts and implications for NetOps safety.

queries.query: ("Mininet" OR ns-3 OR "network emulator" OR "network simulator" OR testbed OR "CI/CD" OR "continuous integration") AND (validation OR evaluation OR "configuration testing")
queries.rationale: Find simulation/emulation environments and testbeds used to execute and evaluate network configuration changes for safety/impact measurement.

queries.query: ("correctness metric" OR "operational impact" OR "policy compliance" OR reachability OR connectivity OR "semantic correctness") AND (network OR "network configuration" OR NetOps) AND (metric OR measurement OR evaluation)
queries.rationale: Compile meaningful, operationally-relevant metrics for quantifying correctness/safety of LLM-generated NetOps actions.

queries.query: (Batfish OR "network verification tools" OR "configuration analysis" OR "policy verification") AND (LLM OR "language model" OR "automation")
queries.rationale: Search for integrations or comparative studies that combine established network-verification tools (Batfish, Veriflow) with generative models or automation pipelines.

queries.query: ("human-in-the-loop" OR "operator-in-the-loop" OR oversight OR "explainability" OR "trust") AND (LLM OR agent OR "autonomous system") AND (NetOps OR "network operations")
queries.rationale: Investigate human oversight models, explainability requirements, and operator trust when deploying LLM-assisted NetOps workflows.

queries.query: (provenance OR reproducib* OR "prompt provenance" OR logging OR audit OR "change management") AND (LLM OR "language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Collect practices and tooling for reproducible, auditable LLM-driven change pipelines—necessary for compliance and post-hoc analysis.

queries.query: (compliance OR audit OR regulation OR "change control" OR "configuration audit") AND (network OR NetOps OR "configuration management") AND (automation OR "LLM" OR "AI")
queries.rationale: Identify regulatory, compliance, and audit concerns for automated/LLM-generated network changes and relevant countermeasures.

inclusion_criteria: Primary peer-reviewed papers (conferences/journals) and peer-acknowledged preprints (arXiv) relevant to LLMs and NetOps
Tool and project primary sources (Batfish, Veriflow, Mininet, ns-3) and their documentation
Empirical studies reporting evaluation methodology, datasets, or metrics
Papers on network verification, formal methods, and configuration validation (including older seminal works)
Works on LLM failure modes, hallucination, robustness, and mitigation strategies
Human-in-the-loop, explainability, governance, and compliance literature directly applicable to NetOps tooling
Public repositories and reproducible artifacts (GitHub) accompanying papers
exclusion_criteria: Non-evidentiary opinion pieces, unsourced blog posts, or unverified claims unless authored by major vendors and accompanied by technical documentation
Proprietary or private datasets/tools inaccessible for reproducibility (unless their public documentation contains methodological detail)
Papers outside the intersection of generative models/agents and network operations unless they present transferable methods (exclude generic NLP-only works without operational linkage)
Duplicate or derivative summaries that do not add primary evidence
Pre-lock internal development artifacts (per programme constraints)
date_rationale: Cover foundational network-verification literature (2000–present) to include seminal methods, and focus on recent LLM/agentic work from ~2018–2026 to capture rapid developments in generative models, validation pipelines, and AIOps. Include older formal-methods sources as needed for validators and correctness metrics.
